meaning:
κρέας, -έως, pl., κρέα
[in LXX for בָּשָׂר (freq.) ;]
flesh, meat: Rom.14:21, 1Co.8:13.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: It is good to not eat meat, drink wine, nor do anything by which your brother stumbles, is offended, or is made weak.
Therefore if food causes my brother to stumble, I will eat no meat forever more, that I don’t cause my brother to stumble.
